subject.name: Goblin Warrior
subject.cue: Small Fey (Goblinoid), Chaotic Neutral_ _The standard rank-and-file raider, armed with bows and rusted blades., CR 0.25 — signature move: Multiattack

style.exactBlock: Style block: Pixel-art sprite rendering (visible pixel grid, retro game-sprite look, NOT a smooth painterly illustration, NOT cartoony — proportions stay grounded and true-to-tone even rendered at pixel scale). traditional Monster Manual fantasy illustration turned pixel-sprite, warm parchment-adjacent palette, painterly dithered shading, medium value contrast, no genre-bending — this is Genesis's actual default/unreskinned fantasy world, the baseline every other realm departs from.

states.label: Idle / characteristic ready
states.cue: Characteristic ready or resting expression; alert and alive, never mannequin-neutral.

states.label: Furious
states.cue: Anger or hostile intent at maximum readable clarity without changing equipment.

states.label: Wounded
states.cue: Pain and strain, still recognizably the same individual with the complete loadout.

states.label: Grim
states.cue: Resolve, dread, or sorrow held under control; readable even at small play scale.

states.label: Triumphant
states.cue: Relief, pride, or victory without adding trophies, props, or replacement gear.

states.label: Afraid
states.cue: Alarm or fear; non-humanoids communicate it through stance, eyes, ears, tail, wings, or compression.

identityLocks: Preserve the exact individual: apparent age, face/head anatomy, body plan, proportions, skin/fur/scales, and major markings.
Preserve every clothing, armor, weapon, and carried-equipment identity; keep them on the same side of the body.
Preserve realm palette, pixel grid/density, outline language, value hierarchy, and lighting direction.
Preserve camera, facing direction, apparent world scale, grounding, and foot/contact line.
Do not add or remove limbs, horns, wings, tail sections, equipment, trophies, scenery, or replacement effects.
Do not turn states into progressive action frames; each cell must stand alone as one readable portrayal.

production.aspectReason: Subject-derived: source visible silhouette is approximately square (1.046 width/height).
production.camera: Match the source sprite's ground-level/eye-level view, facing direction, and projection exactly.
